mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketnews ( token_id, news_type, title, summary_short, summary_text, avg_change_rate, adr_value, adr_text, vol_growth_rate, highlight_tokens, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tokenId}, #{newsType}, #{title}, #{summaryShort}, #{summaryText}, #{avgChangeRate}, #{adrValue}, #{adrText}, #{volGrowthRate}, #{highlightTokens}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT news_id AS newsId, token_id AS tokenId, title AS title, summary_short AS summaryShort, summary_text AS summaryText, news_type AS newsType, avg_change_rate AS avgChangeRate, adr_value AS adrValue, adr_text AS adrText, vol_growth_rate AS volGrowthRate, highlight_tokens AS highlightTokens, created_at AS createdAt FROM marketnews WHERE news_type = #{newsType} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT news_id AS newsId, token_id AS tokenId, title AS title, summary_short AS summaryShort, summary_text AS summaryText, news_type AS newsType, avg_change_rate AS avgChangeRate, adr_value AS adrValue, adr_text AS adrText, vol_growth_rate AS volGrowthRate, highlight_tokens AS highlightTokens, created_at AS createdAt FROM marketnews WHERE news_id = #{newsId}
